build_criterion_from_args: build a FairseqCriterion from argparse.Namespace args and a task object using build_criterion
create_custom_criterion: create a custom criterion class by extending FairseqCriterion and implementing the forward method
compute_loss_forward: compute the loss for a model and sample by calling the forward method on a criterion
reduce_metrics_logging: reduce and log aggregated metrics from data parallel training using the reduce_metrics class method
add_criterion_args: add criterion-specific command-line arguments to an argparse parser using the add_args static method
